# Stepper

> Static and interactive workflow steps with horizontal and vertical layouts.

This file matches the installed `stepper` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/stepper.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/stepper.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `lucide-react@^1.47.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Composition

### Interactive steps

```tsx
<Stepper>
  <StepperList>
    <StepperItem>
      <StepperTrigger>
        <StepperIndicator />
        <StepperTitle />
        <StepperDescription />
      </StepperTrigger>
      <StepperSeparator />
    </StepperItem>
  </StepperList>
  <StepperContent />
</Stepper>
```

### Static steps

```tsx
<Stepper>
  <StepperList>
    <StepperItem>
      <StepperIndicator />
      <StepperTitle />
      <StepperDescription />
      <StepperSeparator />
    </StepperItem>
  </StepperList>
</Stepper>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import {
  Stepper,
  StepperDescription,
  StepperIndicator,
  StepperItem,
  StepperList,
  StepperSeparator,
  StepperTitle,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/stepper";

export function PrimitiveStepperExample() {
  return (
    <Stepper className="w-full max-w-2xl">
      <StepperList aria-label="Publish a project">
        <StepperItem step={0}>
          <StepperIndicator />
          <StepperTitle>Connect</StepperTitle>
          <StepperDescription>Link the repository.</StepperDescription>
          <StepperSeparator />
        </StepperItem>
        <StepperItem step={1}>
          <StepperIndicator />
          <StepperTitle>Configure</StepperTitle>
          <StepperDescription>Set the build options.</StepperDescription>
          <StepperSeparator />
        </StepperItem>
        <StepperItem step={2}>
          <StepperIndicator />
          <StepperTitle>Publish</StepperTitle>
          <StepperDescription>Deploy the project.</StepperDescription>
        </StepperItem>
      </StepperList>
    </Stepper>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `stepper`
  - `content`: `data-state` (`active` | `inactive`)
  - `description`: `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-responsive`
  - `indicator`: `data-invalid`, `data-state` (`complete` | `current` | `neutral` | `upcoming`)
  - `item`: `data-disabled`, `data-invalid`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-responsive`, `data-state` (`complete` | `current` | `neutral` | `upcoming`), `data-step` (any value)
  - `list`: `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`)
  - `root`: `data-content-mode` (`all` | `current`), `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-responsive`
  - `separator`: `data-invalid`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-responsive`, `data-state` (`complete` | `current` | `neutral` | `upcoming`)
  - `title`: `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-responsive`
  - `trigger`: `data-invalid`, `data-state` (`complete` | `current` | `neutral` | `upcoming`)
